The Tome is an app for iPhone and iPad to browse and find spells, monsters and items from the System Reference Document (SRD). A great quick reference app for your Dungeons & Dragons games.

Features:

- Spells, Monsters and Items from the SRD.
- Runs on iPhone and iPad (including multitasking).
- Very (very!) fast.
- Favorites.
- History
- Save favorites to PDF or print it.
- Dark mode.
- iCloud sync.
- Spotlight search.
- XML Import (Lion's Den format).
- Apple Watch App!
